name: Global Pays – Payments for WooCommerce
author: Global Pays

sections.description:
Integration with the Global Pays payment gateway to enable PIX, Boleto and credit card payments in WooCommerce.

Supported Languages

  • English (en_US)
  • Portuguese (Brazil) (pt_BR)

External services

This plugin uses the following external services:

API
– Usage: Payment processing via PIX, credit card, and bank slip using a homologation and production environment.
– Data Sent: Financial transaction information, including amounts, products, and customer data.
– When: During payment creation, consultation, and refund.

api.qrserver.com
– Usage: Display the PIX QR Code on the order screen using the public service.
– Data Sent: Only the PIX payload already generated, sent on date.
– When: In order confirmation (post-PIX creation) and on “waiting for payment” screens.

Third-party

JsBarcode (MIT): https://github.com/lindell/JsBarcode

Policies

  • Privacy Policy

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

= How do I set up payments via PIX, credit card, or bank slip?
After activating the plugin, go to your WooCommerce payment settings and enable the “Global Pays” payment options for PIX, Boleto, and/or Credit Card.

What are the minimum requirements to use the plugin?

You need at least WordPress 6.1 and PHP 7.4 to run the plugin.

License

This plugin is licensed under GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Access your WooCommerce settings to configure your payment methods.
sections.changelog:

  • Versão plugin’s initial integration with PIX, Boleto and Credit Card payment methods.
